name: Takhti
summary: School office desk for daily attendance, monthly fee vouchers, defaulters and late fines
about: A school office dashboard for a Pakistani private school. Mark the daily register by tapping names, generate monthly fee vouchers with sibling discounts, print bank, school and parent copies, and chase defaulters with late fines added, all in PKR. Built for school owners, principals and fee clerks.
how: Open Attendance, pick a class and section, then tap a name to mark Absent, tap again for Leave, again for Present. A chalk tick or cross draws itself and the day saves by itself.
Use Mark all present, move between days, and read the month strip and the most-absent list for the section.
Open Fee vouchers, switch months, and use Generate vouchers for next month. Sibling discounts come from the family code.
Click a voucher to see it, Mark paid to slam a PAID stamp on it, or Print 3 copies (bank, school, parent).
Open Defaulters to see months due and late fines, switch to By family for one reminder per family, and tap the chat button to open a ready WhatsApp text (wa.me link).
Edit fees per class, the due day, fine per day and sibling discounts in Settings, or reset the demo school.
